en: Color postcard showing a central European city square with historic buildings. A tall clock tower with a star on top dominates the left side, attached to an ornate building. In front of the buildings is a square with flower beds, paved walkways, and people walking. A mounted equestrian statue stands on a pedestal in the square. The view is taken from behind a decorative metal railing. The reverse side has Hungarian handwriting, a green Hungarian postage stamp, and printed postcard information including the place name.
